_comment: Safe-to-commit Real mode overlay (no secrets). Copy values into appsettings.{Environment}.json, Container Apps settings, or a local gitignored override. Supply AzureOpenAI:ApiKey via dotnet user-secrets, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY / AzureOpenAI__ApiKey, or @Microsoft.KeyVault(...) — never commit raw keys. See docs/library/FIRST_REAL_VALUE.md and appsettings.KeyVault.sample.json for hosted Azure.
